name: insert-and-delete-lines
about: IL and DL move whole lines within the screen. A DL DISCARDS the lines it removes: it is not a scroll, and the line leaving the top of a scroll becomes history while the line leaving the top of a delete is gone. Upstream implements DL as a scroll up, so deleted lines reached scrollback and moved where a client's history begins. This is roost patch P5; see third_party/alacritty_terminal/ROOST-PATCHES.md.
